decisions.reason: Laptop-based guidance for keywords and KDP uploading does not change the cover design, content, format, dimensions, or editorial-review requirements.
The source changes how KDP upload guidance will be provided, not the required back matter or author copy.
The upload-guidance workflow does not alter the paperback interior layout or trim-size requirements.
Guidance through keywords and KDP uploading is independent of the manuscript copyediting requirements and approved passages.
The source does not change chapter illustration selection, placement, sizing, or rendering-quality requirements.
The KDP upload workflow has no entailed effect on removal of the literal newline artifact from the book title.
The source does not modify the copyright page publisher line, content, or layout.
Laptop-based upload guidance does not affect Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, line roles, or capitalization.
The source neither resolves nor changes the existing uncertainty about the interior title page layout.
